#.label: Adyen (local) – settings (preview)
Settings for Adyen terminals that talk t: Settings for Adyen terminals that talk to the checkout over the store network, through an app that runs on the checkout. Use the target finder at the top to pick the tenant, a group or a store. Every checkout below uses them unless it has its own. Each checkout's terminal is entered under “Adyen (local) – terminals”. Which tenders use Adyen local is chosen on the tender, not here.
#/properties/environment.label: Environment
#/properties/environment.description: Where payments are sent. Production means real payments. Sandbox is Adyen's test system. Mock is Extenda Retail's simulator, so nothing reaches Adyen or a terminal. Switch to Production only when the store is ready to go live.
Live mode: real cards are charged. Use i: Live mode: real cards are charged. Use it only in live stores.
Test mode: Adyen's test system answers. No real money moves.
Simulator mode: Extenda Retail's simulat: Simulator mode: Extenda Retail's simulator answers instead of Adyen. Nothing reaches a terminal.
#/properties/apiKey.label: API key
#/properties/apiKey.description: The Adyen API key the checkout uses at start-up to point the terminal's status messages to this checkout. In Adyen the key needs the roles “Terminal settings read and write” and “Terminal advanced settings read and write”. The second role is not self-service: ask Adyen Support to enable it. Treat it like a password.
After a terminal has been pointed at a c: After a terminal has been pointed at a checkout, restart the terminal or run a forced configuration update from Adyen. Until then it keeps its old settings.
The key you share with Adyen to protect: The key you share with Adyen to protect the messages between the checkout and the terminal. It must match the key set for the terminals in Adyen.
#/properties/encryptionKeyIdentifier.des: The name of the encryption key shared with Adyen.
#/properties/encryptionKeyPassphrase.des: The passphrase of that key, at least 12 characters. Treat it like a password.
#/properties/encryptionKeyVersion.label: Key version
#/properties/encryptionKeyVersion.descri: The version number of the key. Leave it at 1 unless Adyen has told you otherwise.
#/properties/receiptLineWidth.label: Receipt line width
#/properties/receiptLineWidth.descriptio: The number of characters per line on the card receipts the checkout prints (customer and merchant copy). The default is 42. Match it to the width of the receipt printer.
#/properties/webhookPort.label: Status message port
#/properties/webhookPort.description: The network port on the checkout where the terminal sends its status messages, for example “card inserted”. Exactly four digits, for example 8888. The port must be free on the checkout and not blocked in the store network.
